Environmental Science

[1] Purposes

The environmental science program prepares students to describe and measure the natural systems they will work in, and to communicate what they find to the people who decide what happens next. Graduates go on to agencies, consultancies, and graduate school.

[2] Baccalaureate Degree: Bachelor of Science

[2.1] Common Core for All Environmental Science Majors

ENSC 1103 Introduction to Environmental Science 3

BIOL 1543 Principles of Biology 4

CHEM 1103 University Chemistry I 4

GEOL 1113 General Geology 4

[2.2] Biology Track (50 hours)

BIOL 2013 Ecology 3

BIOL 3013 Conservation Biology 3

[2.3] Chemistry Track (51 hours)

CHEM 2613 Organic Chemistry I 3

CHEM 3504 Analytical Chemistry 4
